The '''Defense of the ''Anvil''''' was a series of skirmishes following the [[Evacuation of Yavin]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] ''[[Maximus]]'' was fatally damaged during an ambush from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Nihil (Imperial-class)|''Nihil'']]. The ''Maximus''{{'}} personnel were forced to evacuate to the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|escort frigate]] [[Anvil (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Anvil'']] and other support ships while defended by the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] of [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]]. A team led by [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] consisting of two [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] was dispatched to protect the evacuating ships from Imperial fighters. Though the shuttles, transports and the ''Anvil'' successfully escaped into hyperspace, a number of A-wing pilots were killed, as well as Farlander's wingman.

Shortly after fleeing, the ''Anvil'' came under attack by a group of [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]]. Farlander and a wingman flew A-wings as Red One and Red Two, joining a group of [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] X-wings defended the frigate while it was resupplied by the Rebel corvette ''[[Lauhu]]''. The Rebels then had to contend with fighters launched from the frigate ''[[Firelance]]''. The ''Anvil'' eventually escaped but its damage was too great to repair. A three-X-wing group led by Farlander and a group of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] defended the frigate during the crew's evacuation to the corvette ''[[Hart]]''. The rescue ships successfully escaped, though Farlander's fellow X-wing pilots were killed. Farlander was then ordered to scuttle the crippled ''Anvil'' before he and the Y-wings returned home.

==Behind the scenes==
This battle was depicted in Operations 3, 4 and 5 of the [[Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: Imperial Pursuit|''Imperial Pursuit'']] expansion of the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] computer game.
